sacred_step.truth: Being chosen was never about earning it — it was about Gods initiative, not your performance.
sacred_step.embrace_affirmation: I am chosen by God, not because of what I have done, but because of who He is. My past does not disqualify me from His calling.
sacred_step.practice_action: Write down one lie you have believed about being not chosen, and cross it out today.
sacred_step.closing_prayer: Father, thank You that my past does not get the final say. Help me drop old labels and walk boldly as Your chosen child today. Amen.

sacred_step.truth: I did not find God first. He pursued me long before I turned around.
sacred_step.embrace_affirmation: I am not chasing after worth I have to prove. God chose me before I ever chose Him, and that settles the question of my value.
sacred_step.practice_action: Say out loud, God chose me, before you leave the house today.
sacred_step.closing_prayer: Lord, thank You for pursuing me in my darkest season. Settle my worth in Your love today. Amen.

weeks_overview.title: Becoming Who God Says I Am

sacred_step.truth: The old things are not fading away on probation — Scripture says they have already passed away in Christ.
sacred_step.embrace_affirmation: In Christ, yesterday is finished. I am not under probation for my past; I am Gods new creation.
sacred_step.practice_action: Write down one old label or mistake on paper, physically cross it out, and write New Creation beside it.
sacred_step.closing_prayer: Father, thank You that my past does not get the final say. Lead me into new life today. Amen.

daily_podcasts.episode_title: And Such Were Some of You

sacred_step.truth: The word were is past tense — your past choices are where you have been, not who you are.

sacred_step.closing_prayer: Father, thank You for the word were. Remind my soul that I am washed, clean, and brand new in Your eyes. Amen.
